thesis_statement: Parker-Hannifin is a leading motion-and-control and aerospace-components manufacturer whose decentralised operating system has steadily expanded margins, with a growing, high-margin aerospace aftermarket.

base.summary: High-single-digit revenue growth with continued margin expansion (fiscal Q4 operating margin 23.9%) and strong free cash flow.

bull.summary: Industrial cycle recovery on top of aerospace strength drives operating leverage.

bear.summary: Industrial recession hits short-cycle demand while the premium valuation compresses.
